title: OpenAI unveils GPT-5.6 amid US AI regulatory drama
brief: OpenAI launched GPT-5.6, a new model suite featuring Sol (flagship), Terra (mid-tier), and Luna (affordable) variants, following pressure from the Trump administration to stagger model releases. The suite excels at coding, cybersecurity, biology, and long-horizon agentic tasks, with Sol priced at $5/$30 per million tokens—undercutting Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.
